package.name: race_docking_mission
package.description: Search-phase-only mission node for the RACE AUV docking redesign. Publishes desired_odometry (target pose+twist) and actual_odometry (EKF pose+twist, converted to the same odom-consistent representation) for race_docking_control to consume -- no frame-transform work is left for the control package except the final tau-to-thruster mapping.
